title: Run eligible Semi-automatic stages automatically
description: Start eligible Semi-automatic stage chains without requiring per-stage clicks, preserve fail-closed retry behavior, and repair the Competitor DNA response contract that currently stops the chain.
businessContext: Editors should not have to approve every valid internal stage, while invalid outputs must still stop safely with an explicit retry path.
acceptanceCriteria: Eligible Semi-automatic chains start automatically after project load or a successful stage recovery, with no duplicate active run.
Automatic execution stops only for an actual failed or needs_attention stage and leaves an explicit retry path.
Competitor DNA accepts the documented uncertainty response shape without weakening evidence validation and uses a new prompt fingerprint.
